title: Ankhorage Kubernetes
summary: Provides deterministic Kubernetes workload projection and reconciliation behind an authenticated Kubernetes API boundary.
purpose: Share standard Kubernetes workload lifecycle behavior across runtime adapters without making Kubernetes itself a selectable provider.
responsibilities: Project portable infrastructure workloads into deterministic Kubernetes resources.
Reconcile projected resources through an injected authenticated Kubernetes API.
Provide a shell-free kubectl-backed API implementation for trusted host composition.
boundaries: Does not provision Kubernetes clusters or select infrastructure providers.
Does not own runtime-specific cluster bootstrap such as k3s or Minikube lifecycle.
Does not resolve secret values into projections or expose them in observations and errors.
audience: Infrastructure runtime adapters that target Kubernetes-compatible clusters.
Hosts that need reusable Kubernetes projection and reconciliation behavior.
useCases: Project portable workloads into Kubernetes Deployments, Services, volumes, configs, and secret references.
Reconcile the projected workload through an authenticated cluster API.
Compose a kubectl-backed Kubernetes API for an existing context.

architecture.role: A provider-neutral Kubernetes workload driver used as an implementation dependency by cluster runtime adapters.
invariants: Portable infrastructure intent enters through published Contracts types.
Cluster authentication and command execution stay behind the Kubernetes API boundary.
Resolved secrets are excluded from deterministic projections and diagnostic evidence.

configuration: A host must supply authenticated Kubernetes access or configure the kubectl-backed API.
security: kubectl commands are executed as argv arrays without a shell, and secret manifests are supplied through standard input.
limitations: Cluster provisioning and provider selection remain outside this package.
